# dsh-compact-panel-nav
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-compact-panel-nav) [](LICENSE)
A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that compacts the top of the sidebar: **Plugins / Automations / Mor
e** collapse from three stacked rows into one, and **New Session** leaves its own full-width row to
become an icon at the right end of the brand row. Together that returns about **130px** to the works
icon at the right end of the brand row. Together that returns about **130px** to the workspace list.
压缩侧边栏顶部的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：「插件 / 自动化任务 / 更多」三行合并成一行，「新会话」从整行按钮收成图标放到品牌行最右侧 —— 一共给下面的工作区列表腾出约 13
的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：「插件 / 自动化任务 / 更多」三行合并成一行，「新会话」从整行按钮收成图标放到品牌行最右侧 —— 一共给下面的工作区列表腾出约 130px 高度。
## What it does / 它做了什么
- **Expanded sidebar**: the three panel rows become a single 32px row of three equal cells, icon + l

abel centered.
- **New Session** leaves the flow and becomes a 28×28 icon-only control at the right
end of the brand row, same size as the sidebar toggle. Its tooltip keeps the accessible name and the

`⌘N` hint.
- **Collapsed 56px rail**: untouched — the navigation keeps its vertical icon stack, and

New Session returns to its shipped place in the rail.
- Everything else stays as shipped: the brand
identity, row order, hover/active states, focus rings, keyboard access, and the More menu.

- **展开态**：三行合成一行，32px 高、三等分、图标与文字居中。
- **新会话**：离开文档流，变成品牌行最右端的 28×28 纯图标控件（与右上角收起按钮同规格），tooltip 里仍然有

「新建会话 ⌘N」。
- **收起态（56px 图标栏）**：完全不动 —— 导航保持竖排图标，新会话回到它在窄栏里的原位。
- 其余一律不动：品牌标识、顺序、hover/选中态、焦点样式、键盘可达性

。
- **收起态（56px 图标栏）**：完全不动 —— 导航保持竖排图标，新会话回到它在窄栏里的原位。
- 其余一律不动：品牌标识、顺序、hover/选中态、焦点样式、键盘可达性、More 菜单。
## How it works / 实现方式
**Navigation — CSS only.** The rules target the navigation landmark by its accessible name, which th
e sidebar derives from its own `panels.label` dictionary (`全局面板` in the shipped Chinese locale, `Glo
bal panels` in English). A `:has()` guard requires an icon + title pair inside a row, which only the
expanded sidebar renders, so the collapsed rail keeps its original layout.
**New Session — no reparenting.** The button stays where React put it; the script only switches that
one element to `position: absolute`, measures the brand strip once against the button's own parent,
and writes the geometry (28×28, vertically centered, right-aligned) inline. Nothing is written onto
the brand row or any other node, so a measurement can never squeeze the brand identity.
Every precondition is checked before anything is touched: expanded sidebar, the button is the siblin
g immediately before the nav, the strip above it is a `div` that holds no button of its own (that re
jects the macOS window-control strip), and the button contains an icon. If any check fails, the butt
on is left exactly as shipped. Collapsing the sidebar or disabling the plugin restores the saved inl
tly as shipped. Collapsing the sidebar or disabling the plugin restores the saved inline style text.
The icon-only look — hiding the label and the inline `⌘N` hint, plus the hover background in theme t
okens — is scoped to a data attribute the script sets, so it can never style an unrelated element.
**导航行 —— 纯 CSS。** 选择器只认导航容器的无障碍名称（侧边栏自己的 `panels.label`：中文「全局面板」、英文「Global panels」），再用 `:has()` 判断行内
是否出现「图标 + 标题」——只有展开态成立，因此收起态保持原样。
**新会话 —— 不搬家。** 按钮仍在 React 放的位置，脚本只把这一个元素改成 `position: absolute`，以**它自己的父元素**为基准量一次品牌行，把几何值（28×28、垂直
居中、右对齐）写成内联样式。品牌行与其它任何节点的内联样式一个都不碰，所以「量错就把品牌挤没」那种事故在结构上不可能发生。
[该节后续省略]
## Install / 安装
This is a profile bundle: a package whose `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, with a `./clie
nt` module for the browser half. It is published on npm as `dsh-compact-panel-nav`, so there are two
le for the browser half. It is published on npm as `dsh-compact-panel-nav`, so there are two routes.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility and known limits / 兼容性与已知限制
- Verified on DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3** (Desktop, macOS), Chinese UI. `package.json` declares

`engines.dsh` as `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`, which the host checks before loading.
- Depends on the acces
sible name of the panel nav (`全局面板` / `Global panels`). A future release that renames that label, or

a third UI language, makes the plugin a no-op instead of breaking the layout.
- The New Session mov
e expects the macOS brand strip: a drag strip above the button that holds no button of its own. Wher
e the brand row is itself a button (the Windows/Linux layout), that check fails on purpose and only

the one-row navigation applies.
- Cells are equal thirds, so on a very narrow sidebar a long label (

e.g. 自动化任务) ellipsizes. Widen the sidebar to see it in full.
- Values use theme tokens (`--dsw-radiu
s-*`, `--dsw-alias-*`), so light and dark themes both follow the host.
- 在 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3**（桌面端 / macOS、中文界面）上验证；`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 写的是 `>=0.2.1

-rc.3 <0.3.0`，宿主会在装载前校验。
- 依赖导航容器的无障碍名称；将来改文案或换成第三种语言时，插件会「不生效」而不是把布局弄坏。
- 「新会话进品牌行」依赖 macOS 的品牌条形态（

按钮上方是一条自身不含 button 的拖拽条）。Windows/Linux 的品牌行本身是按钮，该项校验会按设计失败 —— 那里只生效「一行导航」。
- 三等分单元格：侧边栏很窄时较长文案（如「自动

化任务」）会省略；拉宽即可完整显示。
- 配色走主题变量，深/浅色模式都跟随宿主。
